stage: P5.13-D — Step 0 of the ADMM stabilization track: activate calibration C3 and two determinism fixes
status: FROZEN GATE — written and hashed BEFORE any source edit
authorization: author, 2026-09-12: activate C3 (N, D, R) = (10000, 0.80, 0.50), k = 11542, under the impact gate; fold in the two determinism fixes (pin fixed_variable_treatment, replace the warm-start merge with a clean assignment) as stabilization work; stabilize afterwards, not before
rationale: C3 changes the degradation term and therefore the recourse. Stabilizing against the current objective would mean stabilizing against one about to change.

three_changes.C3_activation: the degradation law consumes k = N*D/(-ln R) derived from the calibration triple instead of cl_nom directly; this is INTENTIONALLY NOT NEUTRAL
three_changes.fixed_variable_treatment: pinned explicitly to the value measured as this binary's default, removing the silent dependence on an IPOPT 3.14 default; expected neutral
three_changes.warm_start_assignment: model.ipopt_zL_in/_zU_in are assigned from _out rather than merged into, at BOTH sites (network.py and shared_energy_storage_data.py); expected inert once the pin is in place

measured_facts_required_before_editing.ipopt_default: the default of fixed_variable_treatment must be read from this machine's binary via `ipopt --print-options`, NOT from memory or documentation; the pinned value must equal it or the change is not neutral and must be reported as such

expectations.E1_confinement: exactly ONE constraint component differs between pre and post: energy_storage_capacity_degradation. Every other constraint component, and all sets, params, vars, objectives and named expressions, must be byte-identical. A difference anywhere else FAILS the gate.
expectations.E2_coefficient: the changed rows must carry 2*k = 23083.120654223414 in place of 2*cl_nom = 20000
expectations.E4_determinism: two post-change captures must be identical, including .nl bytes
expectations.E5_reversion_control: setting calibration status back to DECLARED_NOT_CONSUMED must reproduce the PRE-change model byte-identically, proving the activation is the only effective change and is reversible
expectations.E6_consistency_guard: with the calibration ACTIVE, cycles_n must equal cl_nom and reference_dod_d must equal dod_nom, or construction raises; this is what prevents the (count, depth) pair drifting apart again, which is the P5.13-B defect
expectations.E7_warm_start: after the change, the exported ipopt_zL_in/_zU_in key sets must equal the _out key sets exactly, verified by injecting stale keys into _in and calling the production solver-creation function; no solve
expectations.E8_option_pin: the assembled solver options must contain fixed_variable_treatment = make_parameter on BOTH the network and ESSO paths, and a case-level configuration must still be able to override it

not_permitted: any change to rho, tolerances, warm-start pushes, or any ADMM parameter
any change to the degradation law's STRUCTURE — only the constant it consumes changes
acting on S1, S2 or S3 in this stage

decision_rule.pass: E1-E8 all hold; the impact is then exactly the intended coefficient change and nothing else
decision_rule.fail: any expectation violated — revert and report; in particular, a difference outside the degradation rows means the change is not what it claims to be

what_this_gate_does_not_prove: it does not measure the impact of C3 on Q(x) or on any ADMM trajectory; that requires solves and is not authorized here. The impact measured is structural: which rows changed, and by what constant.
the analytic consequence for SoH trajectories is already recorded in P5_13_B_CYCLING_CALIBRATION.md (15-year retention at 1 EFC/day moves 0.5784 -> 0.6223) and is not re-derived here
it says nothing about whether ADMM stabilizes; that is S1-S3
